profile_text: With a strong presence in the German retail market, this Düsseldorf-based clothing and fashion retailer has achieved remarkable growth of 86.6% since its baseline, driven by its successful sales of clothing and fashion items. As a specialist in the wholesale and retail trade sector, the company's focus on fashion has enabled it to expand its workforce to 153 employees by 2024. Its scaler category status reflects the company's impressive expansion and increasing market influence.
